a positive element in the 5' flanking region of the rat hepataic CYP2E 1 gene contains an HNF-1 binding site and is responsible for transcriptional activation of the gene in adult liver but not in fetal or newborn liver or in adult lung.
the rat CYP2E gene is positively regulated by HNF- 1 in adult rats.
HNF-1 is a positive regulator of the rat CYP2E2 gene.

the transcriptional activation of the rat CYP2E gene.
the transcriptional activation of the CYP2 E1 gene in rat hepatocytes during development.
the molecular mechanisms of the transcriptional activation of the rat hepataic CYP2E gene during development.

the CYP 2E1 gene contains three protein-binding sites, two of which are conserved between the human and rat genes.
CYP2E gene is positively regulated by HNF- 1 in rat liver.
the rat CYP2E gene is transcriptionally activated by HNF-2, and this factor is present in fetal and newborn rats, as well as in adult rats.

the CYP gene family is regulated by multiple mechanisms.
